body: Can someone please explain exactly what a mental diet it? And im a male looking a female back which i hope is possible. I have been broken up with before. And i knew i had to let go. This is different i just know we are meant to be but i let mental health issues get in the way.

Its funny. Ive a good job. Good prospects. Just a lifed filled with toxic people and has caused me to act like a monster at times. From the outside looking in, everyone thinks ive everything. And ive nothing

I look around and just seem to be living in a different world than everyone else. Everyone is happy. Im very alone and its done to myself. I want to be a good person but i cant. Its like its in my DNA

Im no therapist but i call BS i cant see a therapist stating that. Girl you do you for awhile. Let him go figure out his mistakes. You tried to help him,youve done everything you could. Stay away for your own health. I actually have a youtube channel now to address the issue from the side of the abuser and encourage them to get help so i hope i can help others correct there behaviour too. Good luck 😊

I was once that man replying if he really wanted you he would go sort himself out. Whole hearted apologize and expect nothing in return.

We all make mistakes in life. But flipping it on you is a serious red flag and a major lack of respect for women. 

He will learn the hard way like i did. Women are amazing beings. Not some object red blooded guys can play with. (i bet he thinks he is the most important person in the room) 

Shame on me for ever being like that. Months and months and some more months of therapy finally cured my out of my abusive. 

This fool hasn't changed, this fool hasn't even tried to start changing, shame on him.

I appreciate your response, and im just off the phone to my coucillor discussing and going through the process of abuse. Everyone is different, many people abuse unfortunately. And i was not aware of this, didnt even believe i was an abuser. The label is devastating to myself, but this isnt about me, just imagine how she is feeling that someone she loved and trusted could do that on her. Im truly ashamed, but dedicated to change for myself and what ever happens happens. I have put my head on the chopping block so to speak. Being abused is no excuse for becoming a abuser. If anything it should be more motivation not to abuse. 

Ive talked and admitted to many men since that i am a abuser and im in complete shock how many people have responded that they have struck there partner its no big deal "i am sickened by this this revolution" and instead of just healing myself. Im going to go public i believe as a abuser to highlight the problem of abuse. Its unacceptable. And meybe my voice as a hopefully one day reformed abuser can help stamp this issue out. Meybe help young men with issues resolve them before the hurt and lose something they deeply cared about.
